definitions.explanation: The amount by which things differ.
Added to adjective stems to express degree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貧富|ひんぷ}→貧富：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: The gap between rich and poor is widening.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{高|たか}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00452_nan⟧⟦メートル→メートル：noentry⟧⟦ですか→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: How many meters is this height?

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the depth of the ocean.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{難|むずか}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦みないと→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦ほど→ほど：01724_hodo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦ではない→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: You won't understand the difficulty of this problem until you actually try it. It's not as easy as it looks.

notes:
{差|さ} expresses difference or, as a suffix, degree.

AS 'DIFFERENCE':
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧{差|さ} (age difference)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{差|さ}→個人差：11654_kojinsa⟧ (individual differences)
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{差|さ} (time difference)
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧{差|さ} (price difference)
- ⟦{貧富|ひんぷ}→貧富：noentry⟧の{差|さ} (gap between rich and poor)

AS SUFFIX (〜さ):
- ⟦{高|たか}さ→高い：00500_takai⟧ (height - from {高|たか}い)
- ⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (width - from {広|ひろ}い)
- ⟦{美|うつく}しさ→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (beauty - from {美|うつく}しい)
- ⟦{難|むずか}しさ→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ (difficulty - from {難|むずか}しい)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is a difference)
- {差|さ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to make a difference)
- {差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}まる→縮まる：18725_chijimaru⟧ (the gap narrows)
